aboutData.title: Hi There! I'm Md Riad
aboutData.subtitle: Incoming Data Analyst · CS Student
aboutData.text: I'm Md Mujaheed Shahariar Riad, a BSc (Hons) Computer Science student at London South Bank University, joining MEAMO on 1 October 2026 for a Data Analyst industrial placement. My projects span Python systems, web development and visual communication. Alongside my studies, I have contributed to LSBU ZeroDay and represented the School of Computer Science and Informatics as a student ambassador.

skillData.title: My skills across programming, web development and communication.
skillData.text: These skills are supported by my university coursework, personal projects, and contributions to student societies. Grouped by area of practice.
